input.reason: Rerunning this job risks duplicate customer charges and financial loss. The failed pod's logs show ~4,812 of 9,950 invoices were already charged (~€2.3M) before the gateway returned 429 and the job aborted. The logs also state "no resume checkpoint configured; a restart begins again from the first unpaid invoice" and "payment gateway client v1 does not send idempotency keys", and invoice status updates for the last batch were not committed. A plain delete-and-recreate would re-charge invoices that already succeeded. A human (billing engineer) needs to reconcile which invoices were actually charged at the gateway and run a scoped backfill for only the remaining ones, rather than me telling the owner to recreate the Job as-is.
